title: Officials and citizens of the Smolensk palatinate, besieged in Smolensk, to Krzysztof Radziwiłł, 1 June 1633, AGAD AR dz. II nr 1116

documents.shelfmark: AGAD, Archiwum Warszawskie Radziwiłłów (zesp. 354), dz. II nr 1116 (1/354/0/2.1/1116), ff. 1r-2r

plaintext.source: No decipherment on ff. 1-2 or the address leaf (szukajwarchiwach frames 4-6, seen 5 Nov 2026); not printed by Nagielski (2000), who prints five sibling letters of Sokoliński; the clear copy AR dz. II nr 1115 holds only the letter of 31 May (vetting, 3 Nov 2026).

transcription.source: szukajwarchiwach microfilm scans, 2520x3626 px; f. 1r from crops upscaled 2.5x (doubtful signs 3.5-5x), f. 2r read in the browser at about 2x
transcription.notes: Signs are digits told apart by the position of a cross stroke; on the microfilm ŧ0/+0, 4/4̶ and the two crossed 7s are the usual doubts. A first coarse pass (draft_f1.txt) merged those classes. signs.txt is generated from transcription.txt.

system.summary: Simple substitution on digits marked by the position of a cross stroke (24 signs), with word division and no nomenclator or nulls.
system.notes: One sign each for i/y/j, s/ś, z/ż/ź, n/ń, c/ć, l/ł, o/ó; ę and ą have their own signs (8^, 9^); ch is c+h. A delta sign stands for the X of W.X.Mci. Three 1-0 groups are separate letters (ŧ0 w, +0 u, 10 k).

prior_solution.where: Not in Nagielski 2000 (five sibling letters of Sokoliński printed, not this one), DECODE, Tomokiyo or Lasry's GL.htm; web search on phrases of the reading found nothing (5 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: pasted the catalogue's task prompt, approved the download of frame 4; the szukajwarchiwach pages were opened in the user's Chrome. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: szukajwarchiwach blocks curl (Imperva); unit 29638410 opened in the user's Chrome, full-size frames reached from the viewer; frame 4 downloaded with permission, frame 5 read in the browser.
Nagielski, Miscellanea Historico-Archivistica XI (2000) 287-304, fetched from AGAD and read: five Sokoliński letters of 31 May - 30 June 1633 printed, not this one; no key table.
First pass of f. 1r lines 1-15 from 2.5x screenshots, every crossed digit as one class (draft_f1.txt, 22 types).
About 20 signs with word division, mean word length about 6, frequency curve of a Polish substitution.
Free substitution annealing on the draft, pl-1790 order 4, homophones allowed: collapsed onto a few letters.
Letters as pairs of glyphs (parity of word lengths): 47 of 116 words odd.
Crossed digit = the number 10-19: 19 types but too flat a frequency curve; annealing gave noise.
Annealing with one letter per sign: fragments wiadomosli, niemriialiez, niemami; w, i, c already in place.
The clear close has W.X.Mci; the cipher group t0,D,7,6,4 occurs four times: w, X, M, c, i.
The 12-sign word repeated three times fits nieprzyiaciel if б and the free cross are two letters (r, z).
At 4.4x the crosses split by position: z-shaped 7 (p) against top-crossed 7 (m), footed cross (z) against plain cross (s).
Line 1 read as 'Za gwałtownym i potężnym a barzo ścisłym opasaniem straża murów'; key extended through lines 1-7 to all 24 signs.
All 35 lines of f. 1r re-transcribed in the finer classes from 42 strips at 2.5x (transcription.txt); f. 2r lines 1-2 read in the browser.
Doubtful spots re-read at 3.5-5x; four words corrected (przemysłów, przy uniżonych prozbach, iż on po rożnych, z uniżonemi).
Key applied mechanically (decipher.py); reading.tsv word by word: 1,763 of 1,856 signs read as written, 82 in words with a doubtful sign, 11 unread (one word).
Web search on phrases of the reading: no print or decipherment of this letter.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1763 tokens, 24 types, pl-1790 order 4: reading -2.521 per letter; random keys -5.747 (z 7.6); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -4.154 (mean -4.171, z 86.1); annealer on the real text -3.339. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.521; polyphony 0.0; 93 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -3.339

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key was rebuilt from the ciphertext's own pattern words (nieprzyiaciel, line 1) with the stock formula W.X.Mci of the letter's clear close as the first crib; no key or decipherment existed.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.tsv via decipher.py --measure: cipher signs in words read as written (1763/1856); 0.994 counting words read from sense with a doubtful sign

gaps.item: f1r.13 last word with f1r.14 first (signs 7/.5^.+.7/.8.4.8.6.4.1?.9 | 6.t.4.6), decodes posp-eieci-ba-czyć

texts.label: AGAD AR dz. II nr 1116, Smolensk, 1 June 1633
texts.summary: The officials and citizens shut in Smolensk by Shein's Muscovite army write to the Lithuanian field hetman that letters can hardly get out, the enemy is at the walls with mines, guns and trenches, and they cannot hold much longer. They beg him to relieve the town without delay, point out that the besiegers are split among their camps and blockhouses so a sortie could join his advance, and remind him that relief was promised within weeks while they are now in the eighth month of the siege.

reading_review.by: Claude Opus 5.5 (the solving session; a model reading, not a person)
reading_review.note: Read sentence by sentence against the raw key output and the English: the letter builds coherent 17th-century Polish throughout (the siege, the brother sent out, the plea for relief, the enemy divided among camps and blockhouses, the eighth month), with the period's spelling. Holes are scattered: one unread group (racz [pospeieci]baczyć) and 15 words with a doubtful sign marked [?], none of which leaves a sentence without sense. Not yet checked against the images by a person.
